title: gofib: Go CLI printing the first 100 Fibonacci numbers
description:
Build a small Go CLI named gofib in this repository.

Requirements:
- Go module 'gofib' at the repository root (go.mod, go 1.27).
- Command 'gofib' prints the first 100 Fibonacci numbers, one per line, prefixed with their index, e.g. '1: 1', '2: 1', '3: 2', ... up to '100: 354224848179261915075'.
- F(100) exceeds int64: use math/big.
- Package main lives in main.go; the Fibonacci computation lives in a separate function Fib(n int) *big.Int so it is unit-testable.
- Add fib_test.go with table-driven tests covering F(1), F(2), F(10), F(100).
- No external dependencies (stdlib only).
- 'just qualitygate' must pass: gofmt clean, go vet, go build ./..., go test ./...

Done when: running 'go run .' prints exactly 100 lines with correct values and the quality gate is green.

title: gofib: add -n flag to control how many Fibonacci numbers are printed
description:
Extend the existing gofib CLI with a -n flag.

Requirements:
- Default behavior unchanged: 'gofib' prints the first 100 Fibonacci numbers, one per line, '<index>: <value>'.
- 'gofib -n 10' prints exactly the first 10 numbers in the same format.
- Use the flag package (stdlib). The flag must be named n, usage text must explain the default.
- n must be >= 1; invalid values (0, negative) cause a non-zero exit with an error message on stderr.
- Extend fib_test.go: table-driven tests for n=1, n=10, and the default path; one test for the error case (n=0) asserting non-zero exit and stderr message (use os/exec or extract the run logic for testability).
- No external dependencies. 'just qualitygate' must pass.

Done when: 'go run . -n 5' prints exactly 5 lines with correct values and the gate is green.

title: gofib: add -json flag for machine-readable output
description:
Extend the gofib CLI with a -json output mode.

Requirements:
- New bool flag 'json' via the flag package: 'gofib -json' or 'gofib -json -n 5'.
- JSON mode emits one JSON object per line (JSON Lines), each object exactly:
  {"index": <int>, "fib": "<value-as-string>"}
- fib values are big numbers; serialize them as strings to stay JSON-safe.
- Text mode (default) unchanged: '<index>: <value>'.
- Both flags combine: -json -n 10 emits exactly 10 JSON lines.
- Invalid usage (n < 1) still exits non-zero with stderr error, in both modes.
- Extend fib_test.go: table-driven tests for run() covering json+n=1,
  json default, and combined -json -n 10; assert exact JSON lines
  (unmarshal each line and compare fields).
- No external dependencies (stdlib only: encoding/json allowed).
- 'just qualitygate' must pass.

Done when: 'go run . -json -n 5' emits exactly 5 valid JSON lines with
correct fib values and the gate is green.

title: gofib: add -pretty flag for aligned column output
description:
Extend the gofib CLI with a -pretty output mode.

Requirements:
- New bool flag 'pretty' via the flag package: 'gofib -pretty', 'gofib -pretty -n 10', and 'gofib -pretty -json' are all valid.
- Pretty TEXT mode: two aligned columns, right-aligned index and value:
    '   1:                    1'
    '   2:                    1'
    '  10:                   55'
    ' 100:  354224848179261915075'
  The index column width is the width of the largest index; the value column width is the width of the largest value. Both right-aligned, separated by ': '.
- The largest index/value depend on n: for -n 5 the widths come from the 5th line, not the 100th.
- Pretty JSON mode: JSON Lines, same objects as -json ({"index":<int>,"fib":"<string>"}); -pretty only affects text mode. Document this in the flag usage text.
- -pretty with -n: both combine (pretty text for exactly n numbers).
- Default output (no -pretty) unchanged: '<index>: <value>' with single spaces.
- Extend fib_test.go: table-driven tests for run() covering pretty+n=5 (exact expected 5 lines including padding), pretty default (assert line count 100 and the exact last line), pretty+json (identical lines to -json for n=3). Compute expected strings in tests, do not hardcode F-values beyond small n.
- No external dependencies. 'just qualitygate' must pass.

Done when: 'go run . -pretty -n 5' prints the exact aligned 5-line block above (widths from the 5th line) and the gate is green.

title: gofib: add -version flag
description:
Add a -version flag to the gofib CLI.

Requirements:
- New bool flag 'version' via the flag package: 'gofib -version'.
- With -version, print exactly one line to stdout: 'gofib <semver>' with
  semver taken from a package-level const Version = "1.3.0", then exit 0.
- -version takes precedence over all output modes: 'gofib -version -pretty'
  and 'gofib -version -json -n 5' also print only the version line.
- Add a table-driven test covering run() or main-level behavior for
  -version alone and -version combined with -json (assert the single
  version line and exit 0).
- No external dependencies. 'just qualitygate' must pass.

Done when: 'go run . -version' prints 'gofib 1.3.0' and the gate is green.
